verses.saheeh: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
verses.khattab: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Glorify the Name of your Lord, that is, exalt your Lord above what does not befit Him (ism [in isma rabbika, ‘the Name of your Lord’] is extra), the Most High (an adjective qualifying rabbika, ‘your Lord’),
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey nabi) Apne Rubb-e-bartar kay naam ki tasbeeh karo

verses.jalalayn: ﻿Who created and proportioned, His creature, making it of well-proportioned parts, without irregularities,
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne paida kiya aur tanasub qayam kiya (then proportioned it)

verses.khattab: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Who determined, what He wants, and guided, to what He had determined of good or evil,
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne taqdeer banayi phir raah dikhayi

verses.saheeh: And who brings out the pasture
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Who brought forth the pasture, [Who] caused herbage to grow,

verses.khattab: then reduces it to withered chaff
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then made it, after verdancy, blackened stubble, desiccated broken chaff.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir unko siyah kuda karkat bana diya

verses.saheeh: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
verses.khattab: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We will have you recite, the Qur'an, so that you will not forget, what you recite,
verses.romanUrdu: Hum tumhey padhwa dengey phir tum nahin bhuloge

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُ ؕ اِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ الۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفٰى ؕ
verses.transliteration: ill<u>a</u> m<u>a</u> sh<u>a</u>a all<u>a</u>hu innahu ya'lamu aljahra wam<u>a</u> yakhf<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
verses.khattab: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except what God may will, that you forget, by abrogating its recitation and its ruling — the Prophet (s) used to recite aloud while Gabriel recited, fearing to forget, and so it is as though it was said to him, ‘Do not hasten in it; you will not forget and so do not weary yourself by reciting it aloud’; assuredly He, exalted be He, knows what is overt, of words and deeds, and what is hidden, of both of these.
verses.romanUrdu: Siwaye uske jo Allah chahey.Woh zahir ko bhi jaanta hai aur jo kuch posheeda(hidden) hai usko bhi

verses.saheeh: And We will ease you toward ease.
verses.khattab: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We will ease your way to the easy way, the uncomplicated Law, namely, Islam.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hum tumhein aasaan tarikey ki sahoolat dete hain

verses.saheeh: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
verses.khattab: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So remind, admonish by the Qur'an, in case the reminder should be of benefit, to the one whom you might remind, the one mentioned in [the following verse] ‘he [who fears] will be reminded’, in other words, even if it might not be of benefit, for it is of benefit to some but of no benefit to others.
verses.romanUrdu: lihaza tum naseehat karo agar naseehat nafey(faiydamand) ho

verses.saheeh: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
verses.khattab: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He who fears, God, exalted be He, will be reminded, by it, as in the verse: So admonish by the Qur'an him who fears My threat [Q. 50:45];
verses.romanUrdu: Jo shaks darta hai wo naseehat qabool karlega

verses.saheeh: But the wretched one will avoid it -
verses.khattab: But it will be shunned by the most wretched
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but the wretched one (al-ashqā means al-shaqī), that is to say, the disbeliever, will shun it, that is, the reminder, in other words, he will leave it aside, not looking at it,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ussey guraiz karega woh intehayi bad-bakht

verses.saheeh: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
verses.khattab: who will burn in the greatest Fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿he who will be roasted in the greater Fire, the Fire of the Hereafter, the lesser fire being that of this world;

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوۡتُ فِيۡهَا وَلَا يَحۡيٰى ؕ
verses.transliteration: thumma l<u>a</u> yamootu feeh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> ya<u>h</u>y<u>a</u>
verses.khattab: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die
verses.jalalayn: then he will neither die therein, and find rest, nor live an enjoyable life.
verses.romanUrdu: phir na usmein marega aur na jiyega

verses.saheeh: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
verses.khattab: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Successful, winner, indeed is he who purifies himself, [who] cleanses himself by means of [his adherence to] faith,
verses.romanUrdu: Falah paa gaya woh jisne pakizgi ikhtiyar ki

verses.saheeh: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
verses.khattab: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and mentions the Name of his Lord, saying Allāhu akbar, ‘God is Great’, and prays, the five prayers — and such are the concerns of [one working towards] the Hereafter, [concerns] which the Meccan disbelievers shun.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur apne Rubb ka naam yaad kiya phir namaz padhi

verses.saheeh: But you prefer the worldly life,
verses.khattab: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but you prefer (or read yu’thirūna, ‘they prefer’) the life of this world, to the Hereafter,
verses.romanUrdu: Magar tumlog duniya ki zindagi ko tarjeeh detay ho

verses.saheeh: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
verses.khattab: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting
verses.jalalayn: ﻿whereas the Hereafter, and the Paradise it entails, is better and more lasting.
verses.romanUrdu: halaanke aakhirat behtar hai aur baqi rehne wali hai

verses.saheeh: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
verses.khattab: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly this, the success of those who purify themselves, and the Hereafter being better, is in the former scrolls, the ones revealed before the Qur'an,
verses.romanUrdu: Yahi baat pehle aaey huey saheefon(scriptures) mei bhi kahi gayi thi

verses.saheeh: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
verses.khattab: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the scrolls of Abraham and Moses, the ten scrolls of Abraham and the Torah of Moses.
verses.romanUrdu: Ibrahim aur Moosa ke saheefon mein
